Name: Old Tea Sapling Sell Price
Author: blompMods
Description:
[center][b]Old Tea Sapling Price
[/b][/center]
[b]Description:[/b]
This mod takes you back to the days before Stardew Valley 1.6, restoring the nostalgic (and more profitable) pricing of the Tea Saplings...

[b]Features:[/b]

Changes Tea Sapling price back to 500g from the 250g set in version 1.6.

[b]Requirements:[/b]

[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (Stardew Modding API): Required to load and manage the mod.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]: Essential for applying the mod changes without altering the game files directly.

[b]Installation:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Ensure SMAPI and Content Patcher are installed.
[*] Download the mod and extract the zip file.
[*] Copy the '[i]OldTeaSaplingSellPrice[/i]' folder into your '[i]Mods[/i]' directory in the Stardew Valley installation folder.
[*] Run the game using SMAPI to enjoy the restored Tea Sapling price!
[/list]
[b]Compatibility:[/b]

Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 and above.
Compatible with most other mods, unless they also modify the price of Tea Saplings.



[center][b]Happy Farming![/b][/center]
